label: panukb-EUR-k15
representation: pairwise r (Near Band, Far Pairs, Partner Rows)
source: https://pan-ukb-us-east-1.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/ld_release/UKBB.EUR.ldadj.bm (r_ij = C_ij / sqrt(C_ii * C_jj); oriented to engine A1), lifted over by hg19ToHg38.over.chain.gz; Pan-UKB published QC: MAC >= 20, INFO > 0.8; not reapplied
notes: imported from Pan-UKB's published LD matrix, not built from genotypes; served only after ogdb-api#194 and ogdb-api#195. chr1-14 were written by ogld 0.8.0 and chr15-22 and the join by 0.8.1 (owner ruling, ogld#10), so the provenance's software.ogld reads 0.8.1; its build.wall_seconds is the last run's, not the ~56 h of running in all. rebuild: these are #10's own commands (/data/opengwasdb/work/orchestrate/ogld-88/scripts/run10.sh, results/10/import-time.txt and validate-time.txt), `ogld <sub>` being read as `opengwasdb ld <sub>`: the import ran at 0.8.0 until chr15 was refused (ogld#102), then the same command resumed at 0.8.1, which re-planned chr15, closed chr15-22 and joined, and 0.8.1 validated; 0.8.0's plan differs from 0.8.1's on chr15 alone (3 invalid_frequency). One change from what ran: #10 wrote the Store at /data/opengwasdb/work/ogld/scratch/10/panukb-EUR-k15.store with --work /data/opengwasdb/work/ogld/scratch/10/work and moved it here on the same filesystem, so the commands name its location and a work directory beside it (/data/opengwasdb/ld-stores/panukb-EUR-k15/work, which never existed), which a rebuild moves into its new directory. Its four inputs are recorded with the digests its source.sha256 holds (each file re-hashed equal on 25 November 2026). The variants table was exported from Pan-UKB's UKBB.EUR.ldadj.variant.ht by ogld's scripts/export_panukb_variants.py (now opengwasdb's scripts/ld/) with Hail 0.2.120 on 22 November 2026; its command line is not recorded, and the Hail log (/data/opengwasdb/work/ogld/scratch/10/hail/hail-export.log) holds the query it ran. A full rebuild downloads about 13.9 TB; the acceptance is `pixi run ld-stores rebuild OGL-00012 --out <dir> --plan-only`, its plan compared with #10's (/data/opengwasdb/work/orchestrate/ogld-88/results/10/plan-final.json) by `pixi run ld-stores compare-plan` (#542)
